build.package: banded_solve/runner (standalone, empty [workspace] table, path dependencies on crates/rodas5p-core and crates/rodas5p-integrators)
build.profile: release as in the repository workspace: opt-level 3, fat LTO, one codegen unit, panic abort
build.target_cpu: default x86-64 of the toolchain (no target-cpu or target-feature flag), as the crates are built

storage: Jacobian band in the layout of BandedJacobianFn: row i, column j at i * (lower + upper + 1) + (j + lower - i). W = inv * I - J with inv = 1 / (h gamma). Factors per row: columns i - lower .. i + upper + lower, as in the protected kernel.

arms.A0: BandedStageLu of rodas5p-integrators (Indexed kernel): linearize once in the set-up, then factor and solve_in_place through the StageLinearSystem trait
arms.A1: reference kernel of the measurement program: assembly, pivot search, interchanges, elimination and both substitutions in the operation order of the protected kernel
arms.B: sequential: factors as A1 plus the reciprocal of every pivot; forward substitution as A1; back substitution: the terms of the older unknowns are subtracted first, the newest unknown (row i + 1) last, and the row ends with a multiplication by the reciprocal; the newest unknown is carried in a local variable
arms.C2, C4, C8: partition into P blocks (rule below); pivoted band LU inside each block as A1 plus reciprocals; spikes = block inverse applied to the coupling columns of both neighbouring separators (2 max(lower, upper) columns per block, full length); dense reduced system on the separators with partial pivoting; factorisation, spike substitutions and both substitutions of a solve run over the P blocks in lockstep (inner loop over the blocks); back substitution as B; correction pass x_block -= spikes * x_separators. Errors: zero or non-finite pivot in a block or in the reduced system
arms.BV, CV2, CV4, CV8: B or C(P) with a copy of the right-hand side before the solve and a check after it: error unless max|b - W x| <= 1e-13 * (norm_inf(W) * norm_inf(x) + norm_inf(b)); norm_inf(W) is computed in the factorisation; all of it is inside the measured cost

partition_rule: w = max(lower, upper); separators have exactly w unknowns; m = floor((n - (P - 1) w) / P); blocks 0 .. P - 2 have m unknowns and the last block has m + ((n - (P - 1) w) mod P) unknowns (the frozen row says equal length; a remainder of fewer than P rows goes to the last block, whose extra rows are processed outside the lockstep loop); block p starts at p (m + w); the kernel returns an error when m < w
eta: computed by the harness in double precision for every arm: max_i |b_i - (W x)_i| / (norm_inf(W) * norm_inf(x) + norm_inf(b)); a solution with a non-finite entry and no error counts as eta = infinity (written as the string "inf")

S1.what: W = inv I - J of the V04 Brusselator band (cost_anatomy/runner/src/problems.rs: 2 uv - 4 - 2c, u^2, 3 - 2uv, -u^2 - 2c, coupling c at distance 2, c = (cells + 1)^2 / 50), lower = upper = 2

states.1: u = 1 + sin(2 pi x), v = 3, x = (i + 1) / (cells + 1) (the initial state of V04)
states.2: u = 2 + cos(6 pi x), v = 1 + 0.5 sin(10 pi x)

S1.rhs: uniform(-1, 1), seed 1001 + case index (cases in the order n, state, inv)

S2.what: random strictly diagonally dominant bands: off-diagonal entries uniform(-1, 1); diagonal = sign * (sum of |off-diagonal entries of the row| + 1 + |uniform|) with a random sign; W is the matrix itself (inv = 0, J = -W)
S2.rhs: b = W x_true with x_true uniform(-1, 1) from the same generator after the matrix

S3.what: random bands without dominance: every band entry including the diagonal uniform(-1, 1); W is the matrix itself
S3.rhs: b = W x_true as in S2

S4.what: for P in {2, 4, 8} and lower = upper in {1, 2}: an S2 matrix (n = 1000, seed 4000 + 10 * index(P) + index(lower)) in which, for every separator of the P-partition, the last row of the block before the separator is changed: its entries on columns of that block are set to 0 and its entry on the first separator column is set to 2. The block interior is then exactly singular (zero row); the matrix as a whole is checked by the forward error of A0 against x_true
S4.rhs: b = W x_true as in S2

suites.S5_exploratory: S4 with the diagonal entry of the changed row set to 1e-10 instead of 0 (nearly singular block interior); labelled exploratory, not part of V3

validity_rules.V1: the solutions of A1 equal those of A0 bit for bit in every case of S1, S2 and S3 (an error in one must be an error in the other)
validity_rules.V2: on S1 the arm returns no error and eta <= 1e-14 in every case
validity_rules.V3: on S2, S3 and S4 every case ends either without error and with eta <= 1e-12 or with an error; a case without error and with eta > 1e-12 is a silent failure and makes the arm invalid; a case in which A0 has eta > 1e-12 is reported and excluded for all arms
validity_rules.reported_in_addition: forward error against x_true (S2-S5), largest relative difference to the solution of A0, number of error returns per arm and suite

cost.pattern: one factorisation (assembly of W from the Jacobian band included) and eight solves; before each solve one of eight right-hand sides (uniform(-1, 1), seed 77) is copied into the work vector; the copy is inside the measured cost of every arm
cost.metric: cycles:u of the process (perf stat); instructions:u and task-clock are recorded with it

protocol.order: for each cell: 2 warm-up rounds and 7 measured rounds; in every round every arm in the fixed order A0, A1, B, BV, C2, C4, C8, CV2, CV4, CV8 and then the exploratory arms, each with its three run types; one process per run
protocol.load: /proc/loadavg (1-minute value) before the first and after the last run of a cell; the busy fractions of logical CPU 9 and of its sibling 21 over the cell are recorded from /proc/stat as supporting information
protocol.spread: (max - min) / median of the seven per-pattern costs of an arm
protocol.authoritative: a cell is authoritative for a comparison only if the load is <= 8 before and after and the spread of every arm in that comparison is <= 10%
protocol.re_measurement: a cell that is not authoritative may be measured again at most twice (files m2, m3); every measurement is kept; the first authoritative one decides; without one the verdict is NOT_DECIDABLE and the numbers are diagnostic_only

verdict_rules.comparison_value: median over the seven measured rounds of the per-pattern cost; ratio = median of the arm / median of the baseline in the same measurement
verdict_rules.valid_arm: an arm that meets V2 and V3 (and A1 meets V1)
verdict_rules.PASS: at n = 10000 and at n = 100000 the best valid arm has ratio <= 0.50 to A0 and <= 0.67 to A1
verdict_rules.KILL: every valid arm has ratio > 0.77 to A1 at n = 10000 and at n = 100000
verdict_rules.FAIL: neither PASS nor KILL; stage b is not built
verdict_rules.second_question: partitioning is kept for stage b only if the best valid arm among C2, C4, C8, CV2, CV4, CV8 has ratio <= 0.77 to the best valid arm among B, BV at both deciding sizes
verdict_rules.not_deciding: n = 1000 and every exploratory arm or cell

exploratory: B2: B with the rows of U scaled by the reciprocal pivot in the factorisation, so that the back substitution chain is one multiplication and one subtraction (general bandwidth)
B3: B2 with the forward substitution on carried values (lower = 2 only)
bandwidths lower = upper in {1, 4, 8} at n = 10000 on S2-type matrices

outputs.logs: banded_solve/logs/check_*.log (one CHECK line per case and arm), banded_solve/logs/measure_m<k>_n<n>.jsonl (one JSON line per run)
outputs.results: banded_solve/RESULTS.json built by banded_solve/build_results.py from the logs only
outputs.report: banded_solve/REPORT_KO.md rendered by banded_solve/build_report.py from RESULTS.json
